note: Eighth batch: sources for stronger Cambridge gates on the calculus, trigonometry, algebra, functions, vectors, inequalities, and OCaml topics (scratchpad research A). STEP Support STEP 2 and STEP 3 topic modules (questions, hints, solutions, and the module page that links them); the STEP Questions Database LaTeX source of each STEP paper a gate problem comes from (one file holds the whole paper; no official solutions); Computer Science Tripos Part IA Paper 1 Foundations of Computer Science questions (the pre-2020 ones are in Standard ML and are restated in OCaml, marked adapted); the DAMTP Part IA example sheets Vectors and Matrices 1 and Differential Equations 1 (fetched through curl: the DAMTP server omits its intermediate certificate); and MIT OCW 18.600 Problem Set 10. Each source records its author, licence, licence URL, and the terms printed on the document or its site; fetch.mjs reads only id, course, kind, role, title, and url. Cambridge material: openly published by the University of Cambridge, with no open licence; the DAMTP sheets print a copyright notice, recorded verbatim in terms. Kind tex: saved as .tex and extracted as its own text.
